name: flim-desktop
description: Create a room, invite a friend, and open FL Studio together.
author: flim contributors

scripts.test: node --test test/bridge.test.cjs test/sample-location.test.cjs test/diagnostics.test.cjs test/install-options.test.mjs test/window-fit.test.cjs test/renderer-recovery.test.cjs test/file-transfers.test.cjs test/reliability-0222.test.cjs test/peer-core.test.cjs test/peer-worker.test.cjs test/peer-electron-adapter.test.cjs
scripts.test:files:ui: npm run build -- --outDir dist-files && node test/file-sidebar-ui.cjs
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:files: npm run build:files:native && npm run build -- --outDir dist-files && electron-builder --config electron-builder.files.cjs --win portable --x64 --publish never
